h1: Papua New Guinea tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Papua New Guinea? This page explains the Papua New Guinea tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay

sections.heading: Do you need a Papua New Guinea tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Papua New Guinea. Tourist visas can be applied for online as an eVisa before travelling.

sections.heading: What a Papua New Guinea tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Papua New Guinea tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Papua New Guinea. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Papua New Guinea business visa](/papua-new-guinea-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. Business visits and work need different visas and supporting letters.

sections.heading: Papua New Guinea tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Papua New Guinea tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Papua New Guinea.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Papua New Guinea tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Papua New Guinea tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Papua New Guinea on a Papua New Guinea tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Papua New Guinea tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
